label: lem:O
trust_note: formal (stage 3, session R11) for every polynomial over F_2 with quadratic support (IsQuadSupp: exponents 0, 2^i, 2^i+2^j, i<j<m) over F = F_{2^m}, m odd; display (1) for F_2 coefficients is derivative_quadratic; gcd is EuclideanDomain.gcd in F_2[t] (its only unit is 1, so this is the monic gcd). The formal proof does not use a normal basis: #ker phi(sigma) = 2^(deg phi) for phi dividing t^m-1, from a root bound and #ker (phi psi)(sigma) <= #ker phi(sigma) #ker psi(sigma); ker kappa(sigma) = ker g(sigma) by Bezout. The hypothesis 'reduced' is not needed.

label: thm:B
trust_note: formal: P' = g^l, P+1 = g^l E, g separable with 2^s roots in F_{2^{2s}} minus (F_{2^s} union F_q), gcd(g,E)=1 over F_2, P = 1 at the roots, multiplicity l as a root of P+1 and of P'. Paper only: reading these multiplicities as ramification indices / different exponents of P^1 -> P^1, the point at infinity (Riemann-Hurwitz), the fibre over 1.
